default_campaign.description: Whether or not this is the default campaign for accounts or plans without an assigned dunning campaign.

type.description: The type of invoice this cycle applies to.

applies_to_manual_trial.description: Whether the dunning settings will be applied to manual trials. Only applies to trial cycles.

first_communication_interval.description: The number of days after a transaction failure before the first dunning email is sent.

send_immediately_on_hard_decline.description: Whether or not to send an extra email immediately to customers whose initial payment attempt fails with either a hard decline or invalid billing info.

days.description: Number of days before sending the next email.

expire_subscription.description: Whether the subscription(s) should be cancelled at the end of the dunning cycle.

fail_invoice.description: Whether the invoice should be failed at the end of the dunning cycle.

total_dunning_days.description: The number of days between the first dunning email being sent and the end of the dunning cycle.

total_recycling_days.description: The number of days between a transaction failure and the end of the dunning cycle.

created_at.description: When the current settings were created in Recurly.

updated_at.description: When the current settings were updated in Recurly.

created_at.description: When the current campaign was created in Recurly.

updated_at.description: When the current campaign was updated in Recurly.

deleted_at.description: When the current campaign was deleted in Recurly.
